officialInventory.summary: No single consolidated official list. Inventories are split by managing authority: TANAPA (national parks; 21 park sections on its website, Kigosi National Park was revoked by GN 616 of 2023), TAWA (an official table of game reserves, game controlled areas and wildlife management areas with area, region and gazettement GN), NCAA (Ngorongoro Conservation Area), the Marine Parks and Reserves Unit (3 marine parks + 15 marine reserves, Tanzania mainland), and TFS (465 forest reserves incl. 25 nature forest reserves and 18 bee reserves; no public list). Zanzibar's protected areas are managed separately by the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar; no official Zanzibar list could be fetched. Legal instruments (GNs) are indexed on TanzLII. The TAWA table is the most complete official list; the TANAPA list comes from the site's park sections, not from a stated list.

statedCounts.quote: three (3) are designated as Marine Parks
oversees 18 marine reserves and protected areas in the Indian Ocean, covering a total area of approximately 2,000 square kilometers
TFS manages 465 forest reserves of different types with a total of 14.5 million hectares
25 Nature Forest Reserves made of 42 forest reserves with 962,500.64 ha
there are 18 bee reserves with a total of 35,918.28 hectares
includes 16 national parks, Ngorongoro Conservation Area, 28 Game Reserves, 42 Game Controlled Areas, 38 Wildlife Management Areas
three marine parks in Zanzibar (Menai Bay Conservation Area, Mnemba Island Marine Conservation Area and Pemba Channel Conservation Area)

areas.name: Arusha National Park

legalStatus.text: Declaration of Arusha National Park to include Ngurudoto and Meru Forest Reserve Proclamation, 2005 (GN 280 of 2005)

areas.notes: 2005 proclamation extended the park to include Ngurdoto and Meru Forest Reserve (per TanzLII title); original establishment date not verified.

areas.name: Katavi National Park
areas.notes: TANAPA: 'gazetted as a national park in 1974'.

areas.name: Kilimanjaro National Park

legalStatus.text: Declaration of Kilimanjaro National Park Proclamation, 2005 (GN 278 of 2005)

areas.notes: The 2005 proclamation is listed on TanzLII; whether it is the original establishment or a re-declaration of boundaries was not verified (full text not fetchable). The TANAPA Kilimanjaro page repeats a Serengeti-history sentence ('In 1930, a 2,286 square kilometer area ... was designated'), apparently a template error, so no area/year is taken from it. Also a UNESCO World Heritage site.

areas.name: Kitulo National Park

legalStatus.text: Declaration of Kitulo National Park Proclamation, 2005 (GN 279 of 2005)

areas.notes: TANAPA: 'Gazetted in 2005'.

areas.name: Lake Manyara National Park

legalStatus.text: Declaration for Alteration of Boundaries of Manyara National Park (GN 105 of 2009)

areas.notes: Area 648.7 km² per TANAPA ('Spanning 648.7 km²'). GN 105 of 2009 altered the boundaries (TanzLII); original establishment instrument not verified. Lake Manyara is also a UNESCO biosphere reserve (CBD 5NR).

areas.name: Mikumi National Park
areas.notes: TANAPA: 'Gazetted in the 1960s and expanded over time' (exact year not stated).

areas.name: Mkomazi National Park
areas.notes: Area per TANAPA ('Stretching across 3,245 sq km').

areas.name: Nyerere National Park

legalStatus.text: Tamko la Kurekebisha Mpaka wa Hifadhi ya Taifa Nyerere, 2025 (GN 595 of 2025) — boundary revision

areas.notes: Boundary revised by GN 595 of 2025 (TanzLII). Original 2019 establishment instrument not located. Formed from part of the former Selous Game Reserve; overlaps the Selous World Heritage site.

areas.name: Ruaha National Park

legalStatus.text: Tamko la Kurekebisha Mipaka ya Hifadhi ya Taifa Ruaha la Mwaka, 2023 (GN 754 of 2023) — boundary revision

areas.notes: Area per TANAPA ('Spanning 20,226 sq. km'); boundaries revised by GN 754 of 2023 (TanzLII), so the area may predate or postdate that revision.

areas.name: Saadani National Park

legalStatus.text: Declaration of Saadani National Park Order, 2005 (GN 281 of 2005)

areas.notes: Establishment year taken from the 2005 declaration order listed on TanzLII.

areas.name: Saanane National Park

legalStatus.text: Declaration of Saanane Island National Park (GN 227 of 2013)

areas.notes: TANAPA: 'Established as a game reserve in the 1960s and later upgraded to a national park'; declaration as Saanane Island National Park per GN 227 of 2013 (TanzLII).

areas.name: Serengeti National Park
areas.notes: TANAPA: 'Established in 1951'; NCAA notes the 1948 National Park Ordinance implemented in 1951. Also UNESCO World Heritage site (1981, per TANAPA).

areas.name: Tarangire National Park
areas.notes: TANAPA: 'covers an area of 2850 km 2'.

areas.name: Ngorongoro Conservation Area
areas.notes: NCAA: 'NCA was designated a Conservation Area as far back as 1959'; area 8,292 km² (NCAA home page and CBD 5NR table). Also UNESCO World Heritage site (1979) and biosphere reserve (with Serengeti).

notEnumerated.reason: No Zanzibar Government source could be fetched (sites unreachable or blocked); only third-party sources were found, so none are recorded.

notEnumerated.category: wildlife corridors and other recent wildlife declarations
notEnumerated.reason: Only the Nyerere-Udzungwa corridor (GN 226 of 2025) was found; a systematic search of TanzLII for all corridor orders was not possible because full-text pages are blocked to automated fetch.

gaps: TANAPA's website lists 21 national parks but does not state a total count, establishment instruments or areas for most parks; the original declaration GNs for the 2019 parks (Burigi-Chato, Ibanda-Kyerwa, Rumanyika-Karagwe, Ugalla-River, Nyerere) were not found.

Kigosi National Park (2019) is excluded: GN 616 of 2023 ('Tamko la Kufuta Hifadhi ya Taifa Kigosi la Mwaka 2023') revoked it per TanzLII; a 2025 High Court judgment indexed on TanzLII describes the area as now 'Hifadhi ya Msitu ya Taifa Kigosi' (national forest reserve), which could not be confirmed from TFS.

TanzLII document pages (National Parks Act Cap 282 consolidated 2025 with its Second Schedule; individual GNs) are behind a Cloudflare challenge; only titles, GN numbers and dates from the TanzLII search API were used.

TAWA's table has 25 game reserve rows (two rows combine two reserves: Ikorongo & Grumeti; Lukwati & Piti), versus 28 game reserves in the 2014 CBD report; some reserves were upgraded to national parks since 2019 (e.g. Burigi, Biharamulo, Kimisi, Ibanda, Rumanyika, Kigosi, Ugalla parts). TAWA areas are rounded figures for many reserves.
TAWA's table lists 25 game controlled areas and 21 WMAs, versus 42 GCAs and 38 WMAs (33 established) in the 2014 CBD report; differences could not be reconciled.

Marine reserve names are given by MPRU only as island names; individual gazettement years are known only for the four DMRS islands gazetted in June 1975. Mnazi Bay-Ruvuma Estuary Marine Park's gazettement could not be read from the GMP PDF.

Zanzibar: Jozani-Chwaka Bay National Park, Changuu-Bawe and other Zanzibar conservation areas could not be verified from official sources; the three Zanzibar marine areas are recorded only from the 2014 CBD report.

Ramsar sites (Malagarasi-Muyovozi, Kilombero Valley Floodplain, Lake Natron) and the Kilwa/Songo Mnara cultural heritage site appear in the TAWA table but are not recorded as separate areas per the brief.
No official coordinates were found for any area.

Wikidata QIDs were matched (search + entity check of label, P17 country and P31 type) only for national parks and selected major reserves; the Wikidata API was heavily rate-limited (HTTP 429) during this run, so other areas were not attempted or the lookup failed. A null QID does not mean no item exists.
